title: When Agentic Executions Fail: Detecting and Localizing Runtime Faults from Telemetry
abstract: arXiv:2608.14680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reliability in LLM-based agentic systems is a property of the whole execution (its tool calls, model calls, guardrails, and inter-agent messages), not of the final answer alone, yet evaluating only task outcomes reveals little about how or why a run fails. We present AGENTCHAOSBENCH, a benchmark for detecting and localizing runtime faults in agentic systems from their execution telemetry. We run five heterogeneous applications that coordinate agents over the Agent-to-Agent protocol and call tools through the Model Context Protocol, and inject ten types of operational fault (unavailable or slow tools, corrupted or oversized responses, and delayed, looped, or misrouted delegations and bypassed guardrails) at their tool, model, guardrail, and inter-agent boundaries, alongside a no-fault control. translated_title: 当代理执行失败时：从遥测中检测和定位运行时故障
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14680v1 公告类型：新 摘要：基于LLM的代理系统的可靠性是整个执行过程（其工具调用、模型调用、护栏和代理间消息）的属性，而不仅仅是最终答案的属性，然而仅评估任务结果几乎无法揭示运行失败的方式或原因。我们提出了AGENTCHAOSBENCH，这是一个基准测试，用于从执行遥测中检测和定位代理系统中的运行时故障。我们运行了五个异构应用，这些应用通过代理到代理协议协调代理，并通过模型上下文协议调用工具，并在其工具、模型、护栏和代理间边界注入了十种类型的操作故障（不可用或慢速工具、损坏或过大的响应，以及延迟、循环或错误路由的委托和绕过护栏），同时设置了无故障对照组。由此产生的数据集包含275条净化痕迹：250条覆盖十种故障类型的故障执行和25条无故障对照。每条故障痕迹都...
tldr: 本论文提出了AGENTCHAOSBENCH基准，通过注入十种运行时故障并分析执行遥测，实现了对LLM代理系统中运行时故障的检测与定位，填补了仅评估最终结果而忽视执行过程故障的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AGENTCHAOSBENCH, a benchmark that injects ten runtime fault types and analyzes execution telemetry to detect and localize runtime faults in LLM-based agentic systems, addressing the gap of evaluating only final outcomes while ignoring execution failures.
